scope: Larger-model batch-one decode estimates for Ryzen AI Max+395/Radeon8060S. Metadata and existing results only; no new GPU job or full-model throughput claim.

hardware.caveat: Derived specification maximum, not a measurement of current memory clocks, sustained GPU bandwidth or Laptop power limits. Laptop32GB and Bosgame128GB have different capacity, thermals and possibly operating conditions. Desktop7900XTX is NOT this estimate target.

local_measurements.meaning: Nominal traffic divided by whole decode latency, not an independent DRAM-copy bandwidth measurement
local_measurements.comparison_caveat: Historical/noninterleaved, F16 vs F32 KV and close but nonidentical quantization; no isolated causal attribution to an individual kernel.

published_same_processor_benchmark.publisher: LiquidAI; vendor measurement, not independently reproduced
published_same_processor_benchmark.method: CPU llama.cpp on Ryzen AI Max+395, Q4_K_M quants,100 generated tokens. Different engine/quantization from our projections; backend and power/configuration details not fully specified in chart.
published_same_processor_benchmark.short_context: At1024 input tokens, chart approximately112 for LFM2-24B-A2B,78 for gpt-oss-20b,76 for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Approximate visual readout, NOT exact raw samples.
published_same_processor_benchmark.coding_caveat: LiquidAI explicitly does not recommend LFM2-24B-A2B for coding. It also has32K context and a model-specific license. It is evidence for sparse-model speed, not our Julia backbone recommendation.

implementation_state.dense_qwen: Validated2B/4B full runner; not every larger/config variant has been loaded or validated
implementation_state.qwen_moe: Existing routed-expert quantized kernels have CPU/GPU synthetic correctness qualification and35B checkpoint/header audit. Full35B/80B loading, complete native-logit parity and end-to-end generation are NOT established by those checks.
implementation_state.gpt_oss: Would need native MXFP4 or explicit requantization, expert biases/router/attention-sink/window semantics and tokenizer/template support. Native MXFP4 checkpoint does not mean the entire model is4bit.
implementation_state.gemma_lfm: Coarse active-count estimates only; no complete engine port. KV estimates deliberately withheld pending architecture-specific implementation.
implementation_state.qwen38_flash_next: Publisher lists125B backbone with6B active PLUS51B n-gram embeddings and4B MTP. QSA, widened/gated residuals and lookup tables require separate accounting/port. Not mislabeled as an ordinary3B-active MoE; speed intentionally withheld.

interpretation: 50..100tps is plausible for larger low-active-parameter MoEs at short/moderate context, not ordinary12..20B dense Q4 batch-one decoding. Sparse weights must stay resident, native/requantized formats must be distinguished, and long-context KV can erase the advantage. Speculative decoding/low-bit quantization can change the single-token traffic assumptions but need quality/parity/acceptance measurements.
